answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A glacier ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A meadow expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A signal renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 4216 identities cost 247 paid peers, 227497 tokens of stake and 27554 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
